args.title: Corvid Packaging Newsletter Summary – Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter: "Freight pricing this quarter" from Corvid Packaging highlights the quarter's freight market trends.
- Linked article: Spot freight rates dropped 9% this quarter while contract rates stayed stable; fuel surcharges are now tied to weekly diesel price movements.
- Companion piece: Shippers who diversified volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs.
